# Project Governance 2.6.1

This patch makes repeated-check observations easier to investigate without adding execution controls.

- `project-governance telemetry status` shows up to five bounded repeat examples with prior and
  current run references, outcomes, and retained durations. It separates runtime versions, stages,
  triggers, scopes, and subjects; examples are diagnostic observations, not permission to skip checks.
- Work guidance points agents to existing evidence when repetition is reported, rather than
  inspecting history before every command.
- The source charter establishes a design principle: diagnose first, add the smallest change that
  earns its cost, and remove what no longer helps.

Normal check execution, telemetry collection, and the stored schema are unchanged. No cache,
automatic retry, blocking gate, or new collector is added. Field efficiency benefits remain unmeasured.
Eligible repositories already using compatible startup updates from 2.5.0 can adopt this patch
without changing their startup integration.
